product_summary: Website (kryfs.com, home + /transformers/ + /about/) shows: (1) CRGO lamination & cores — India's largest transformer-core converter, 50,000 MT/yr capacity, silicon steel slit coils, cut-to-size laminations for 11 kV–1200 kV class transformers, built-up/assembled cores up to 50 MT, core & coil assembly up to 50 MT, toroidal cores, unicores, CT active parts; (2) transformers — distribution 10 kVA–3 MVA 33 kV, power up to 10 MVA 33 kV, inverter-duty/solar multi-winding transformers, manufactured at Silvassa/Vadodara (KRYFS Transformers Pvt Ltd); (3) transformer tanks and heavy steel fabrication up to 765 kV class (KRYFS Fabrications, Bhopal, 5000 MTPA, PGCIL/NTPC approved); (4) amorphous cores; (5) EPC, rooftop solar, IoT DTMS 'BOLA'; (6) material handling and stringing tools; (7) lifting slings (Slingset, Slingmax USA collaboration). Ten plants: Kherdi (DNH), Palghar (MH), Savli (GJ), Bhopal (MP).
role_hint: manufacturer (own plants; company history states it 'commenced operations in December 1992 as a manufacturing and trading company' — trading element present historically, but current profile is a multi-plant manufacturer; no trader-only signs)
comment: Declared HS 850490 is CORRECT for the core business (transformer cores, core-coil assemblies, CT active parts are parts of transformers of 8504) — match: partial, because the declaration covers only one of several real product lines. Missing from the declaration: complete transformers (8504.31/8504.33/8504.34 — a major line, up to 10 MVA 33 kV, incl. exports to Confidence Electric Ltd., Bangladesh per site), CRGO slit coils and laminations (7225.11/7226.11 — arguably the largest volume line, 50,000 MT/yr), fabricated transformer tanks (7326.90/7308.90), amorphous cores, lifting slings (6307.90), IoT monitoring devices (8543.70), and EPC/solar services (no HS). Industry 'Энергетика' is broadly right but imprecise: the primary activity is electrical-steel processing/transformer-core manufacture (metals/electrical equipment), with transformers, fabrication and EPC as additional segments. No industry misclassification of the trader type. All product claims above are from the company's own website — no customs line was available in this task, so every product line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at HS-line level; the only shipment statement on the site (10/14 MVA 33/11 kV power transformers to Confidence Electric Ltd., Bangladesh) is likewise 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Per Rule 3, no rejection: company retained, HS list corrected/expanded. Note: kryfs.com/transformer-tanks/ and /crgo-lamination/ returned binary/image content and could not be read; the amorphous-core page returned 404 — those lines are taken from the site navigation and the About page only.
